topic: The US imposed a 39% tariff on Swiss-origin goods (2025-26), including watches, making imported luxury watches dramatically more expensive overnight -- and how the ultra-wealthy structure purchases through other jurisdictions to avoid VAT
title: A $10,000 Watch Just Got $4,000 More Expensive
description:
The US just added a 39% tariff on Swiss-origin goods, and watches are one of Switzerland's biggest exports -- meaning a $10,000 watch costs roughly $4,000 more overnight. The personal duty-free exemption is only about $800, nowhere close.
